svg.title: FIG-03 Current configuration and generation: build-time data flow only
svg.desc: One authored TOML assembly; package.json Facts, binding_files and build entry; SoC / CPU / routes / review facts; Board wiring and electrical authorization; Strict field checks Frozen AuthoredAssembly; One controlled snapshot of selected inputs Byte identities and pre-publication recheck; Generic DataProvider / domain and IP policies BindingPolicy and private schemas; Generic resolution and resource decisions Modes, references, conflicts, budgets; Immutable named IR Shared canonical references; Bounded static assembly Objects, references, fixed calls and thin IRQ entries; Transactional generation and atomic publication; Static C / factory / config / memory plan resolved.json: one-way audit projection; Package CMake: the sole C source target graph; Ninja: compilation, linking and resource checks; This execution: ELF / BIN / map / resource reports; Input, resolution, generation or publication failure; Invalidate only the owned bundle Do not reuse stale or partial output; Sole assembly input; Explicit selected files; Declared facts; Authorization conditions; Bindings and facts from one generation; Exact device and Board facts; Frozen user selections; Maintained policies; Validated; Named fields and fixed references; Selected recipes / fragments; Render static connection C; One-way configuration and audit projections; Successful publication; Generated configuration and sources; Select build entry; no second .c graph; Execute the sole target graph; Actual artifacts; Invalid fields; Invalid or changed input; Invalid mode or conflict; Invalid static connection; Generation or publication failure; Invalidate this attempt's owned output
